legend.orientation: rows top to bottom as drawn; 10 columns, column 0 the left wall
legend.c: a filled cell (any piece or garbage; the video is read by occupancy only)
legend.C: a filled cell in a row the spin clears (muted)
legend.U: a cell of the T the spin places

nodes.label: the video at about 4.0 s, before the T: a flat slot, nub down
the video's first T-spin (about 4.0 s): a TSD, the T flat, nub down; the T-spin before the TST
the video at about 9.0 s, before the T: a slot one column wide, three deep, open to one side
the video's second T-spin (about 9.0 s): a TST, the T stood up, nub right

variants.rule_note: a full T-spin Triple at lock j whose slot the previous T-spin i opened: i cleared lines, no T locks between them, j's four T cells (mapped back through every clear and garbage row between) were covered before i's clear and empty right after it, at least one column's top T cell was open to the sky right after it, over such a column pieces placed after i roof the slot, and the slot box (the T rows and the row under them, the T's columns and one each side) was already complete right after i's clear, so only the roof is built between them; mid-game (lock > 21), at a T no other technique page and no opener route owns (accidental-qualify.ts). The window is the T's own box: the rule reads the round's locks, not a drawn shape.

cross_source.note: the variants are rules over the corpus (window_basis spin_rule): no drawing fires them by construction, so there is no window for a routes board or another site's drawing to check. The exclusions are measured instead, in accidental.test.ts: every qualifying hit has no other technique page's hit at the same T and no opener route owns it.
cross_source.routes_fire_none: a spin_rule variant fires on no board (technique_transcription.window_fires returns False for it), so no routes board is recorded

video.probe: 1920x1080, 30000/1001 fps, 11.13 s (ffprobe); a phone filming a monitor
video.reading: two boards read by eye off single frames (about 4.0 s and 9.0 s), occupancy only, rows only as deep as the slot needs; the T's cells are where it locked
